mappings.text: Benchmark artifacts distinguish tokenizer counts, provider-reported usage, actual billed amounts, and estimates; missing values remain explicitly unavailable rather than zero.
Cost calculation includes analysis, synthesis, TypeSafe, and attributable cache/retry charges, using recorded rates and usage sources; unavailable components prevent a verified savings claim.
Recomputing a summary preserves recorded human decisions and historical runs; focused checks cover missing usage, arithmetic reconciliation, and decision preservation.
Record which cost evidence is obtainable and any precise external evidence still required, without claiming that financial savings have been established prematurely.
Record the production-versus-fixture payload diagnosis and implement a documented reduction in duplicated or unnecessary triage input with reproducible before/after payload measurements.
Relevant tests cover preserved evidence signals, disabled/error fallback, and appropriate cache invalidation for changed inference inputs; repository-required validation passes for touched code.
Preserve the original evaluation artifacts and identify the revised payload/question/cache versions so subsequent results cannot be mistaken for the original run.
Prepare the adjusted implementation for the separate live evaluation card; make no claim of preserved model recall or financial savings from synthetic judgments alone.

Save at least three paired repetitions with raw per-call evidence, configuration/hashes, alternating arm order, and separately identified cache conditions; no failed/fallback run is presented as successful model recall.

Record per-run and aggregate end-to-end time, analysis tokens, TypeSafe usage, and supported total cost; label unverified billing components and make no monetary-savings claim where they remain unavailable.
Record adjusted-threshold recall against all 16 positives, all misses, and comparison with the original 16/16 result at 0.7; any regression is explicit rather than silently accepted.
Record a structured comparison of report recommendation quality and evidence support, plus unresolved representativeness limits, for human review.
Reconcile counts, token/cost totals, dependencies between artifacts, and JSON validity; summarize whether adjustments improved the intended outcomes, including negative results.
Workspace verification configuration parses and is accepted by the supported MWNN verifier, with a check mapping for each original criterion of the three named cards.

Independent verification produces dated per-criterion evidence or a precise failure for accounting, payload adjustment and re-evaluation; successful verification does not silently imply provider billing or semantic equivalence.
Record resolution of the missing-input handoff failure, or leave this card incomplete with the exact remaining gap; preserve historical artifacts and product sign-off.

receiptScope: Installed verifier factory run with fresh inputs; receipt held in memory during checks then exported locally. Not a live-loop dispatch receipt. Export changes the repository digest; redispatch captures the final profile and evidence.
